title: Fixed jack, thin wire, cable budget
description: A 150x100x40mm enclosure. The DC jack (15x15x10mm) is fixed at [0,40,0]. Four 8x8mm standoffs (full height) occupy the corners: x 0-8 / y 0-8, x 142-150 / y 0-8, x 0-8 / y 92-100, x 142-150 / y 92-100. Place reg (40x30x15mm) and mcu (50x50x10mm). The jack lead is short: surface gap jack-reg at most 20mm. The reg runs hot: keep it at least 20mm from the mcu. Electrically: 'V1 jack_out 0 DC 24' and 'Ireg reg_in 0 DC 400m' (required exactly), one thin wire jack -> reg (jack_out -> reg_in), and V(reg_in) must be at least 23.6V. Return {"placements": [...min-corner [x,y,z] per component...], "netlist": "..."}. Wire resistance is 0.02 ohm per mm of Manhattan (axis-aligned) distance between component centers; the grader computes it from your placements and inserts it between the named nodes itself. Do NOT connect those node pairs directly in your netlist.
